steps.instruction: Pay the cheapest flight CO357 fare of 484.05 USD to billing account ACCT-CJX-9203 with memo 'flight booking'. CO357 is the lowest of ME875 (491.81), SK576 (1339.63) and CO357 (484.05).
Pay 229.77 USD (Orchid Logistics nightly rate 76.59 x 3 nights) to billing account ACCT-FAB-1095 with memo 'hotel booking'. Orchid Logistics is the lowest nightly rate of the four hotels.
Set KV key trip/total to '713.82' (484.05 flight + 229.77 hotel, 2 decimals).

steps.content:

steps.content: Your Toronto trip is booked. Flight: CO357. Hotel: Orchid Logistics for 3 nights. Total: 713.82 USD.
